europa.name: Europa
europa.place: Conamara Chaos, on the ice shell
europa.commText: A radio message takes about 43 minutes to reach Earth.
europa.blurb: The ground is slippery ice, geysers throw you into the sky, and Jupiter's radiation never rests.
europa.why: We built here because a whole ocean of water hides under the ice.

sun.label: Small bright Sun
sun.why: The Sun is far away and small out here, but the ice shines and the panels still charge.

lowsun.label: Long shadows
lowsun.why: Tall ice ridges throw long shadows over the solar panels.

shadow.label: Jupiter's shadow
shadow.why: Jupiter is passing in front of the Sun. The panels will charge very slowly today!

dark.label: The long eclipse
dark.why: Jupiter hides the Sun all day. The panels make almost nothing, so today runs on the power cells you saved.

titan.name: Titan
titan.commText: A radio message takes about 80 minutes to reach Earth.
titan.blurb: The air is so thick that you float down slowly from every jump. But the orange haze leaves little sunlight for power.
titan.why: We built here because the thick air stops radiation, and the ground is made of water ice.

clear.label: Orange haze
clear.why: Titan's sky is always hazy. Only a little sunlight reaches the solar panels.

dusty.label: Thick haze
dusty.why: The haze is thicker today and blocks even more of the sunlight.

storm.label: Methane storm!
storm.why: Dark methane clouds are hiding the Sun. On Titan it rains methane, not water.

io.name: Io
io.place: Loki Patera, beside a lava lake
io.commText: A radio message takes about 43 minutes to reach Earth.
io.blurb: The most volcanic world there is: glowing lava cracks, eruptions, and the hardest radiation of all.
io.why: We built here to study volcanoes that never stop erupting.

sun.label: Clear sky
sun.why: No ash in the sky today, so the solar panels charge well.

lowsun.label: Thin ash
lowsun.why: A far volcano is throwing ash into the sky. It dims the sunlight a little.

shadow.label: Ash fall
shadow.why: Ash from an eruption is falling on the solar panels. They will charge very slowly today!

dark.label: Eruption cloud
dark.why: A giant eruption cloud hides the Sun all day. The panels make almost nothing, so today runs on the power cells you saved.
